interpretation_boundary: This stage prepares development-only structures and reads no docking score, fresh-validation row, or locked-test row. Preparation success does not establish enrichment, QUBO superiority, quantum execution, or quantum advantage.
next_gate: generate and independently audit the 34-receptor by Train-266 by three-seed Uni-Dock development matrix

preparation.macrocycle_policy: Run Meeko flexible first. If preparation fails or closure pseudoatoms are detected, rerun once with --rigid_macrocycles; require zero closure pseudoatoms in the final PDBQT.
preparation.rdkit_method: ETKDGv3 with explicit hydrogens, useRandomCoords=true, then MMFF94 or UFF with 500 iterations
